buildings.name: The Delta Campus Berlin
buildings.access_notes: Main entrance Donaustrasse 44, keycard access 24/7. Reception on ground floor (Erdgeschoss), staffed Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00. Three passenger lifts in the central atrium serve floors EG-4.OG; the right-hand lift doubles as goods lift for deliveries. Technical room (heating, RLT, main electrical distribution) in the basement (UG), accessed via the service door left of reception - key with facility desk. Each of the 5 floors has a shared kitchen (north side) and two bathroom blocks (east and west wings). Gym on 1.OG. Roof terrace and balconies on 4.OG. After-hours contractor access via facility manager.
buildings.key_holder: Facility desk, ground-floor reception (Tom Berger, facility manager)
buildings.description: A curated startup campus in the heart of Neukoelln offering coworking, private offices for teams of 2-12, and a premium event space across five floors. Built in 1998 and fully refurbished as a workspace, it features three atrium lifts, an on-campus gym on the first floor, shared kitchens and bathroom blocks on every floor, shower facilities, phone booths, and outdoor balconies and a roof terrace on the top floor. High-traffic communal areas mean frequent kitchen-plumbing, ventilation and access-control service needs.
